annotations.title: Get the wind through the year at a place

description: Wind through the year at a place, as its page shows it: for each month, the nights whose strongest hour reached 20 kt and 30 kt, each year's fewest and most of them, the commonest directions of the nights of 20 kt or more, and the strongest gust, over ten years, for the area round the place. The first call for an area can answer preparing, then ready a few minutes later.

bay_id.description: The place's id, as find_anchorages gives it.

month.description: One month, 1 (January) to 12 (December). Every month when left out.

name: get_climatology

each_year_20_kt_or_more.description: Each year's fewest and most nights of 20 kt or more in this month.

each_year_30_kt_or_more.description: Each year's fewest and most nights of 30 kt or more in this month.

mostly_from.description: The commonest directions of the nights of 20 kt or more, at most two.

about.description: The page that explains how the figures are known.

years.description: How many years the wind through the year covers.

title: Get the wind through the year at a place
